verdict.rationale: Box documents an enterprise event feed that lets an application subscribe to actions by any user or service across the enterprise, with real-time monitoring and historical record queries via the authenticated API. This meets the story's 'documented API access' path for team audit logs, and webhooks add push notification of content events. missing for 10: details on event types, retention and admin scoping, any documented SIEM connector or export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
